description: This header file defines the Abseil hash library and framework, including Hash functors, HashState class, and support for extending hashing capabilities for user-defined types.

classes.name: HashState
classes.description: A type-erased class that implements hash state manipulation, supporting combining hash values, contiguous data, and unordered collections.

methods.name: HashOf
methods.description: Helper function to generate a hash from multiple values, dispatching to absl::Hash.

methods.name: HashState::Create
methods.description: Creates a HashState instance that wraps an existing hash state object.

methods.name: HashState::combine
methods.description: Combines multiple values into the hash state.

methods.name: HashState::combine_contiguous
methods.description: Combines a contiguous array of data into the hash state.
